detail: Studio closed due to COVID-19 pandemic; after reopening, stayed out longer as a precaution for the kids. 432 days between classes.
Injured right thumb last week of January 2022; unable to work out for ~6 weeks. 57 days between classes.
Broke a sesamoid in right foot in late April 2023; unable to work out for months. 161 days between classes.
Came back to test the foot, determined OTF (treadmill-heavy) no longer viable, and switched to something else. Last recorded workout.
